claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item_or_object for non-spell activation phases
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing alter_item_kind atom can only be applied honestly if an activation can attach to the weapon itself rather than to self/creature/area.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can take a Bonus Action to alter its form, turning it into a 6-inch rod ... or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate keyed to current item form
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's passive and reactive riders are conditional on whether the same held weapon is currently a quarterstaff, a 10-foot pole, or a rod.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Acrobatic Assist (Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only)" and "Attack Deflection (Quarterstaff Form Only)"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_weapon_profile
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The quarterstaff form grants the Thrown property and explicit 30/120 range values, which changes legal attack options and weapon behavior rather than adding a creature-side bonus.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "This weapon has the Thrown property with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: return_weapon_to_holder
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ranged-attack rider returns the weapon to the bearer immediately after the attack resolves; no existing effect or lifecycle shape models that object movement.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand."
